notes: Selected adverseEventsModule.otherEvents Hypoglycaemia (non-serious adverse events), the closest registry term to the unqualified outcome Hypoglycemia. The outcomeMeasuresModule contains only cardiovascular and renal composite outcomes. Alternative registry entries: seriousEvents Hypoglycaemia, Linagliptin 28/3494 and Placebo 38/3485; seriousEvents Hypoglycaemic coma, Linagliptin 1/3494 and Placebo 1/3485. Both held article documents report a broader outcome of one or more hypoglycemia episodes: linagliptin 1036 and placebo 1024 (treated denominators 3494 and 3485). These differ from the selected non-serious registry counts; registry ownership is used as required. Serious and non-serious counts were not summed. Registry adverse-event timeframe is first dose through 7 days after last permanent study drug stop, up to 4.3 years.
